item.text:
**Assessment**  
Mixed, leaning negative. Jokowi ultimately accepted the constitutional transfer of power and the courts rejected claims of systematic fraud. But the broader 2024 record shows a restrictive speech environment, harassment of journalists and critics, surveillance-style controls, and coercive handling of protest.

**Accepted Claims**
- [Indonesia court rejects election disputes, upholding president-elect Prabowo’s win](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-court-rejects-election-disputes-upholding-president-elect-prabowos-win/2051390/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-04-22. Claim: The Constitutional Court said there was no evidence of systematic fraud or presidential meddling in the election disputes. This is the strongest positive evidence that Jokowi tolerated an opposition victory through formal institutions. IDs: 4B.3, 4B.1
- [Farewell-Welcome Ceremony for Indonesia’s President from Jokowi to Prabowo Subianto](https://setkab.go.id/en/farewell-welcome-ceremony-for-indonesias-president-from-jokowi-to-prabowo-subianto/) - Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia, 2024-10-20. Claim: Jokowi formally transferred power to Prabowo on inauguration day. This is positive evidence for tolerating an opposition victory at the end of the cycle. IDs: 4B.3, 4B.1
- [Indonesia students protest alleged poll interference by Jokowi administration](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-students-protest-alleged-poll-interference-by-jokowi-administration/1963424/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-02-12. Claim: Students and activists publicly protested what they saw as Jokowi’s abuse of power to sway the election. The fact that the protests happened supports some space for criticism, but the allegations themselves cut against the idea of full tolerance. IDs: 4B.3, 4B.2, 4B.1
- [Protests across Indonesia as parliament delays change to election law](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/protests-across-indonesia-as-parliament-delays-change-to-election-law-3582501) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-08-22. Claim: Large protests erupted over election-law changes seen as helping Jokowi’s influence and his son’s candidacy, and security forces used tear gas and water cannon. This shows protest remained possible, but tolerance was limited and coercive policing was used. IDs: 4B.3, 3B.8, 3B.9, 4B.2
- [Indonesia: Freedom on the Net 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024) - Freedom House, 2024. Claim: Government critics, journalists, and internet users continued to face criminal prosecution, violent attacks, and harassment; Kominfo could directly restrict online content without an appeals process; and restrictions and self-censorship chilled criticism. This is strong negative evidence against broad tolerance of criticism, investigative journalism, and civil-society monitoring. IDs: 4B.3, 3B.8, 3B.9, 4B.2
- [Indonesia: Freedom in the World 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-world/2024) - Freedom House, 2024. Claim: The press environment remained vibrant but constrained by legal and regulatory restrictions; journalists faced arrest, harassment, violence, and threats; and activism in Papua and on corruption remained risky. This supports a negative finding on tolerance of investigative journalism and civil-society scrutiny. IDs: 4B.3, 4B.2, 3B.8, 3B.9
- [Indonesian Army Apologizes After Torture Video Goes Viral](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/28/indonesian-army-apologizes-after-torture-video-goes-viral) - Human Rights Watch, 2024-03-28. Claim: The army apologized and detained 13 soldiers after a torture video surfaced, which is a limited positive signal for accountability, but HRW framed it as reactive and insufficient. This only weakly supports tolerance of civil-society scrutiny and criticism. IDs: 4B.3, 3B.1, 3B.2, 3B.4, 3B.7
- [Indonesia: Freedom on the Net 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024) - Freedom House, 2024. Claim: During the coverage period, anonymous political buzzers attacked opposition supporters and disinformation proliferated ahead of the February election. This is negative evidence that critics and monitoring actors faced a hostile information environment. IDs: 4B.3, 4B.2, 3B.8

**Search Gap**
- I found little direct 2024 evidence on satire specifically. The closest proxies are broader press-freedom and online-harassment findings.
- I also did not find a strong source showing Jokowi actively protected investigative journalism or independent civil-society monitoring as such; the best positive evidence is mostly procedural, via the court outcome and peaceful transfer of power.
